tangentialFactors: The source inventory holds no Kocaeli-specific material that can be separated from the country-wide monitoring it comes from. localsOnly: No resident-facing finding specific to Kocaeli is sourced. The inventory records no municipal ordinance, no provincial authority practice, no local police action and no local institution operating in the province.
outOfScopeNotes: The single source in the inventory is a national monitoring report.
